evidence.why: ResourceService is an @Injectable() class, provided in resource-list.module.ts and constructor-injected into ResourceListComponent (resource-list.component.ts), which the DI runtime instantiates when the lazily-loaded ResourceListModule (dynamic import in element-registry.ts) is activated for the aio-resource-list custom element — a real caller with no static call site, matching the rule's described scope of 'similar framework class decorators register the class with the framework's dependency-injection runtime... constructor... invoked by the framework without an explicit call site,' but check_framework_component_decorator's `@Component*` regex does not match `@Injectable`, and its decorator-block scan (anchored to the constructor's own start_line, not the class's) would miss even an `@Component` decorator sitting above the class when the flagged entry is a constructor several lines below it.
